customer_reply:
Hello,

Thank you for reaching out. The behavior you are experiencing is a documented design limit within the eProcurement module. To ensure the integrity of approval audit trails, the system supports a maximum of 200 documents per bulk approval batch. When more than 200 items are selected, the 'Approve' button is disabled by design.

To resolve this, please filter your approval list (for example, by supplier or date) into smaller batches of 200 or fewer items and approve them in separate groups. 

We have noted your feedback regarding the need for a higher limit and have routed this to our Product team for consideration. Please let us know if you have any further questions.

Support Team
